story.text: Metey Engineering & Consultancy Pvt Ltd was established and registered in the combined Andhra Pradesh state in 2013, and has since been delivering projects across India.
points: Its core strengths are Architecture and Structural Engineering.
It focuses on using modern construction technologies — precast, monolithic (Mivan / aluminium formwork), composite, insulated wall (EPS / shotcrete), light gauge steel, Perma form and timber.
These technologies help build durable and sustainable structures in the shortest time, so buildings can be occupied earlier.
Metey follows Green Building principles in its designs.

expertise.intro: The firm was founded by Er. C.A. Prasad, who has 48 years of experience in:
areas: — design of multi-storey towers (low-rise and high-rise), green buildings, earthquake-resistant design
for hotels, office buildings, shopping malls, godowns, workshops, warehouses, function halls and restaurants

paragraphs: As the Director of Metey Engineering & Consultancy, I take immense pride in the journey we have undertaken in the field of architecture and civil consultancy. Since our inception, our mission has been clear — to deliver innovative, sustainable and efficient engineering solutions that stand the test of time.

Our team of dedicated professionals brings together experience, technical expertise and a passion for excellence. Whether it's urban infrastructure, environmental planning, structural design or project management, we approach every challenge with a commitment to quality, safety and client satisfaction.

We believe that collaboration is at the heart of every successful project. By working closely with our clients, stakeholders and partners, we ensure that each solution is not only technically sound but also aligned with the broader vision and goals of the project.
Thank you for placing your trust in us. We look forward to building a better tomorrow — one project at a time.
